description: Every image in the selected records is copied in its original format. Existing files are kept; matching names receive a numeric suffix.
recipe: Include a JSON recipe beside each image
privacy: Recipes include prompts and generation settings. Credentials, endpoints and local file paths are omitted.
cancelled: Export stopped. Completed files are kept.
exportFailed: Export could not finish. Completed files are kept.
cancelFailed: Could not stop export. Check its progress before trying again.

codes.unsafe_source: Source is outside the managed library or is a symbolic link
codes.source_unreadable: Original file could not be read
codes.destination_write_failed: Destination is not writable or does not support atomic file publication
codes.destination_name_conflict: Could not choose an unused filename
codes.verification_failed: The copied bytes did not pass verification
codes.sidecar_failed: Image saved; JSON recipe could not be saved
